charge_aware.conditions: 0<p<pcrit(h), finite real h; pcrit(h)=[1-sqrt(1-4/{9(1+sech h)})]/2. This low-p branch automatically satisfies p<=1/[1+1/(2cosh h)].
charge_aware.proof: The existing convex-current physical Bayes-risk bound gives R_L<=min{1/2, [16L/(3(1-rho_c))]rho_c^(L-1)}. Substitute the exact H12 identity A_L=1-2R_L; no unweighted or signed average is used.

parity_only_complement.conditions: Any finite h and p with r=min(p,1-p) satisfying rho_b=6 sqrt[r(1-r)]<1; in particular p>(3+2sqrt2)/6 or p<(3-2sqrt2)/6.
parity_only_complement.proof: The measured signed charge determines binary syndrome. The old all-active complement reduces p>1/2 to Bernoulli r; a parity-only minimum-chain decoder has failure bounded by the existing Peierls path witness. Bayes with full charge is no worse. Apply H12.

analysis: This supplies a size-uniform physical absolute-contrast certificate in nonempty low-p and high-p square regions for every fixed h. It is a restatement of existing sufficient path theorems in the exact H12 observable, not a newly discovered threshold or a solution of the moderate-p square phase.
claim_boundary: Strict sufficient regions only. At p=.30 and fair/intermediate bias these bounds do not apply; no critical point, universal exponent, line-tension limit or all-p square classification follows.
